annotations.text: Every rhythm in one page: the 12-column mosaic up top (7+5, then 3, then 8+4), a 'Jump back in' band with full-width / 2-column / 3-column rows, then the long tail as a two-column list grouped by time. Unread = filled accent dot; read = grey dot + dimmed title; counts are tabular-figure pills.
The compact artboard keeps the same system at a tighter density, if you'd rather the whole page felt like the band than like the mosaic.
